title: Aligned Corpus Reserve-Substitution Log Record
description: One JSON-Lines record per reserve substitution event. The deterministic, same-stratum substitution is preregistered: when a primary case_card fails the A4 cascade gate (0/3 candidates pass), the selector consumes the (domain, style_slot)-matched reserve. Substitution is bounded to at most one reserve per stratum; a second failure in the same stratum triggers stratum_exhaustion halt.

reserve_id.description: case_card_id of the reserve substituted in.

primary_failure_artifacts.description: Paths to the validator-transcript files that document the primary's A4 failure.
